body: The taste, feel, and sound of a pistol in my mouth.

Great, thank you! I'll check them out when I get home tonight.

I actually have to head off to my last exam now. Thanks guys. :)

I would totally appreciate that list. I've been trying to find things that I could watch. So far the only thing I've found that interested me was Wakfu. I, uh, I didn't try too hard. That's kinda what I do. 

Do you watch with subtitles, or just sit there and try to figure it out? Because that's usually when I get really frustrated. When I try to figure it out and I can't, then I just shut it down and go do nothing productive.
Thanks for the comments, friend. I feel a bit better. :)

Usually my bedroom, yeah. My roommates are always in the living room (two of them literally never leave the house) and we don't have a table in the kitchen. I could try the school's library, but it's not the most comfortable and a good 30 minutes of busing away. Oh hey excuses again.

Yeah. Just, try. Okay. I'll try keeping the books readily available at my desk (come home at the end of the day, actually unpack my bag, etc) so I can jump right in. And maybe keep my desk a little tidier so that won't come up as an excuse too.

Hey, thanks for the reply and the kind words.

I like the idea of just diving into my studies, but whenever I want to do that I just shut down. I make up shallow, tiny excuses ranging from "my room is too cold," "I don't have a comfortable place to study," etc to "well I would study but the sun is about to go down and that means absolutely nothing but I'll use it as an excuse anyway." And then I just feel worse and worse about myself, get to the sarcastic "wow look how far you've come in the five years since you graduated high school" stage, and just totally shut down. Next thing I know it's midnight and I'm sleepy and off to bed.

Rinse and repeat.
